answer: Delay-chain bond: each identity crosses a canyon through 8 checkpoints, each taking one glacier-paced hour of serial work. Each emits a key-stamped plume signal; auditors replay it, and skipping a checkpoint or reusing a plume burns the 70-credit bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 96,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool; hired proofs carry the lender's key, so double use burns it. An honest agent pays 96 once, keeps its share.
